notes.title: Resolution trouble
notes.content:
Hi, you all.

If you are having trouble in starting the game, it may be that your computer doesn't support 1024x768 full screen resolution.

So, to get around this, you can download this file and put it onto Milford's Steam folder. It will make the game runs in windowed mode. Remeber to do not change to fullscreen.


https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B8T1s0TV53yea3c1ejFvY0JZd0k


Regards
CGGAMES
